starting-rag-and-bone-man-i.npc: Can I help you with something?

starting-rag-and-bone-man-i.player: Well, err...who are you, and what are all these bones doing here?

starting-rag-and-bone-man-i.npc: I'm an archaeologist. I work with the museum.

starting-rag-and-bone-man-i.player: Well that explains the bones...sort of...but what are you doing all the way out here?

starting-rag-and-bone-man-i.npc: I'm collecting bones for the museum.
They have asked me to rig up some displays of second and third age creatures using their bones, so that people can come and...well, look at them.
I need to get them into some sort of order before I begin, but I've run into a bit of a snag.
Well, I need to have all the bones I'm going to use here, and placed into some sort of order.
However, I seem to have discovered I am a few short.

options.text: Anything I can do to help?

steps.player: Anything I can do to help?

steps.npc: Errr...
There is something you could do for me. I'm going to be busy...err...
Sorting, yes, sorting these bones out ready for the museum, but I need a few more.
Will you help me out by grabbing some?

steps.prompt: Start the Rag and Bone Man I quest?

steps.player: Yes. I'll give you a hand.

steps.npc: You will?  Excellent!

steps.player: Where do you need me to dig?

steps.npc: Dig?
Oh, you must have got the wrong end of the stick.
I need some fresh, whole bones to replace ones that have become damaged.

steps.player: What?

steps.npc: Err...

steps.player: Excuse me...
Sorry...

steps.npc: Ok, got it.
Ok, here is the thing. While sorting out what bones I do have I managed to lose or damage a few. If you can get me some fresh, unbroken bones to use as replacements then I can get on with things.
That make things clearer?

steps.player: Well, it makes some sense I suppose...

steps.npc: Great. If you can get me a bone from a Goblin, a Bear, a Big Frog, a Ram, a Unicorn, a Monkey, a Giant rat and a Giant Bat then I'll be able to move on with the...
Displays...

steps.player: So you just want me to bring you these bones and that will be that?

steps.npc: Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
There is a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato that sells the stuff you'll need.
You can even use my pot-boiler if you want.

steps.player: Why do I need to boil them in vinegar?

steps.npc: It gets them bright and sparking white.
It's an archaeologist thing.
Just put the bone in a pot of vinegar, throw some logs on the fire, put the pot in the holder and light the logs.
It takes a while for the vinegar to evaporate, but the bone will be nice and clean in the end.

steps.player: All right, I'll be back later.

steps.npc: Bye!

steps.player: No.

steps.npc: Oh...I see.
Well, never mind me young man, I'll just stagger over here under my massive burden, and continue my thankless task.
Unaided and alone...

steps.player: Wow, trying a guilt trip much?
Well good luck with that!

steps.npc: Thanks stranger!
What a polite young [man/woman]...
Well, back to work!

options.text: Where is that mumbling coming from?

steps.player: Where is that mumbling coming from?

steps.npc: Errr...
What mumbling?
Anyway, I have enough problems of my own without dealing with a delusional adventurer.

steps.text: Rag and Bone Man I is started.

steps.player: Yes. I'll give you a hand.

steps.npc: You will? Excellent!

steps.player: Where do you need me to dig?

after-initally-declining-the-quest.player: I was just passing and I wondered if you still needed someone to help with the bones?

after-initally-declining-the-quest.npc: There is something you could do for me. I'm going to be busy...err...
Sorting, yes, sorting these bones out ready for the museum, but I need a few more.
Will you help me out by grabbing some?

after-initally-declining-the-quest.prompt: Start the Rag and Bone Man I quest?

options.text: Where is that mumbling coming from?

after-rag-and-bone-man-i.player: So how is the sorting going?

after-rag-and-bone-man-i.npc: It's going well, especially now I have all the bones I need.
There are still a few bits and pieces I wouldn't mind, but that's the way things go.

after-rag-and-bone-man-i.player: Well if I see any bones I think you might like I'll bring them over.

after-rag-and-bone-man-i.npc: Cheers, we, err, that is myself and the museum staff, really appreciate it.

options.text: Could I exchange this helm for the bonesack?

steps.npc: I don't see why not.

options.text: Could I have a bonesack as well?

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.player: I found this amulet. Do you know what it is?

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.npc: It doesn't look like anything I've seen in the past, I don't think I'll have a use for it.
Although actually, thinking about it, I can take it off your hands if you'd like?

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.player: For free? I've helped the museum enough, do you have anything I could exchange it for?

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.npc: I could give you 30 big bones per amulet, I've built up quite a collection recently.

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.text: If the player has one giantsoul amulet:

steps.prompt: Exchange your Giantsoul amulet (uncharged) for 30 big bones?

steps.npc: Here's 30 big bones, come back if you find another amulet.

steps.player: No thank you. maybe another time.

trading-in-giantsoul-amulet-first-time.text: If the player has more than one giantsoul amulet:

steps.text: How many amulets would you like to exchange?
